rows.grounds: appositional or general object; object of hanti

items.question: Can a recitation measured as seventeen repetitions destroy mouse poison?
premises: Mouse poison is a harmful poison requiring removal.
Recitation is presented as an effective remedial act.
A specific measure of seventeen repetitions is prescribed.
items.inference: Therefore, recitation performed seventeen times destroys mouse poison.
uncertainties: The exact unit counted as seventeen (repetitions, syllables, or another measure) is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: A recitation measured as seventeen destroys mouse poison, that poison.
